title: Count Fertile Pyramids in a Land
goal: Count upright and inverted fertile pyramids of height at least two.
strategy: Directional DP stores the largest fertile pyramid height at each apex. The minimum supported height of the three cells in the next row determines how far the apex can extend; height h contributes h-1 pyramids.
